title: The Passage of Cape Reckoning
author: Emrys Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
